description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol, Slogurk's first triggered ability, and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Slogurk.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning the cycled land and up to two additional land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Slogurk's ability from step 2, failing to put a counter on it since it left the battlefield.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
